sideB.text:
Get Hollow Men to defect.

This objective is completed when there is at least 1 Hollow Men figure on 3 different havens.

Add this card to your pool of objectives. If you complete it, but lose the first game in October, it counts as complete during your second game in October!

mechanics.whenRead: Continue the October setup Legacy-deck reading, after 10-03, which calls this the enclosed mandatory objective.
triggers: Completed when at least 1 Hollow Men figure is on 3 different havens.

rules: Add this card to the objective pool.
Complete it when there is at least 1 Hollow Men figure on 3 different havens.

mechanics.notes: Side A is the objective-card back and carries 10-04a. The face text is printed sideways. The header MANDATORY OBJECTIVE is red. The same haven count is checked again at game end by Turning Point 10-05, which opens door 17. This objective card does not itself open a door.
